items.titleEn: In the case of the reinsurance of the country's schools, the government has won a lawsuit calling for the illegal suspension of the school system.
items.summaryEn: Three years ago, the district government shut down the school district in the village of Macy's, where the village community formed an anti-school association to bring administrative lawsuits, and the Supreme Administrative Court declared the school district's decision process illegal, and declared the village to have won the lawsuit and withdrawn the suspension. The Coalition Against School Abolition is holding a briefing today outside the gate of the school, shouting slogans of celebration, the mayor urging the county to resume schooling as soon as possible in the 116th academic year; acknowledging the response of the county government, respecting the court's decision, and the ongoing deliberations on deliberations and planning as a follow-up.

items.summary: 日本沖繩世界文化遺產「首里城正殿」，在2019年10月，因為一場大火付之一炬，歷經7年重建之路後，昨（22）日舉辦了復原完成儀式，並且在今日中午，正式對外開放參觀。日本中央政府與沖繩縣府，接連2日舉辦盛大的復原慶祝儀式，台灣也因為曾經捐贈5棵珍貴的紅檜木協助重建，前駐日代表謝長廷與現任駐日代表李逸洋，都受邀親自出席觀禮。
items.titleEn: The restoration of the temple in the capital, Okinawa, has been completed and is now open.
items.summaryEn: The World Heritage Site "Chelys Castle" in Tokyo, Japan was officially opened to the public in October 2019 after a seven-year restoration ceremony, which was completed on 22 October 2019 following a fire in one of the buildings. The Japanese central government and the Okinawa prefecture held a grand restoration celebration ceremony on the second day, and Taiwan, which has donated five precious redwoods to help rebuild, invited former Japanese representative Xiangting and current Japanese representative Li Lijiang to attend the ceremony.

items.title: 美軍將引爆5噸含鉛爆裂物 愛荷華州居民憂釀鉛污染
items.summary: 今（2026）年3月，美國陸軍在愛荷華州一處彈藥廠例行檢查時，發現一批存放超過20年、重達近5噸的含鉛爆裂物已經劣化變質。原定在20日引爆，但環保團體擔憂爆炸造成鉛污染，危害居民健康而提起訴訟，法院宣告暫停。但陸軍則以變質炸藥在低溫下恐怕自爆為由，援引緊急豁免條款，繼續執行引爆計畫，日期延到25日。環保團體批評，軍方並未充分評估替代方案，也沒有及時提供居民相關的防護資訊，讓大家措手不及。
items.titleEn: U.S. forces will detonate five tonnes of lead-containing explosives, Iowa residents worry about lead pollution
items.summaryEn: In March 2026, the U.S. Army, during a routine inspection of a munitions factory in Iowa, found that a batch of lead explosive containing nearly 5 tons of lead that had been stored for more than 20 years had deteriorated. The explosion, which was originally scheduled to take place on the 20th, was postponed by environmental groups, who were concerned that the explosion caused lead pollution and damaged the health of residents. However, the Army, which feared that it would detonate itself under low temperatures, continued to carry out the detonation plan, citing the emergency exemption clause, and extended the deadline to 25th. Environmental groups have criticized the military for not fully evaluating alternatives and for not providing timely safety information to residents, leaving people unaware.

items.title: 聯合國氣候峰會破局 化石燃料退場無法達成協議

items.titleEn: The UN climate summit broke down and no agreement was reached on the withdrawal of fossil fuels
items.summaryEn: The 31st United Nations Climate Summit, held on 22 October in Turkey, declared its failure to reach a comprehensive political agreement on the withdrawal of fossil fuels and climate finance. The failure of the climate negotiations has also put pressure on reforms in the climate negotiating mechanism that has been in operation for more than 30 years. In the meantime, some countries have begun to look for new ways to reduce carbon emissions.
